caption_L1: This bar chart is named Average ticket price Orlando Magic games of the NBA from 2006/07 to 2015/16 (in U.S. dollars). The y-axis shows Year with categorical scale starting with 2006/07 and ending with 2015/16 while the x-axis measures Average ticket price in U.S. dollars using linear scale from 0 to 40.
caption_L2L3: Ticket price for an Orlando Magic NBA game was at its lowest in the 2006-07 season, at 35 dollars. In the 2007-08 season this price increases to about 38 dollars. In both the 08-09 and 09-10 seasons the ticket price remained the same - 40 dollars. Throughout the 2010-2011 season this ticket price increased to 42 dollars and in 2011-2012 the price reached its highest total, 45 dollars. In 2012-13 this price began to decrease, and from the 2013-14 season all the way to the 2015-16 season, the ticket price has remained steady, at a price of 39 dollars.
